How to join the Priesthood is a planned video that is the proper end of the video chain. It is a planned future video which will explain to someone in the [[Omega Covenant]] or earlier how to join the [[Lambda Covenant]] with the intention of becoming a priest. 

This is meant to be differentiated from people who wish to join the Lambda Covenant just to achieve ennoblement but without the career intention. 

Becoming a priest doesn't necessarily mean being a parish priest, but it means essentially the people who this video is aimed at are people whose careers will be intimately intertwined with [[Lifeism]]. They may be parish priests, may be influencers, may be researchers.

This video will likely have new versions released periodically in order to ensure it streams people into the correct path. It will be the true end of the [[video path]] and linked from [[Reflecting on the Meaning Crisis]]. 

This video may be the greatest contributor to the available workforce for the [[Church of Evolution]] so it must be kept in very good shape and be very informative.
